responsibility: Implements cached access to source file contents for diagnostics. This file owns the file_cache runtime, including on-demand file loading and optional buffered-content injection, line-by-line and whole-file retrieval, charset/BOM input handling, cache-slot eviction and tuning, recent-line and anchor records for efficient random line lookup, and missing-trailing-newline tracking; it is the subsystem’s source-text provider for caret printing, column conversion, SARIF content, and fix-it application.
same_name_distinction: This is the runtime implementation file for the file-cache pair: it defines file_cache_slot, on-demand file reading, buffering and eviction behavior, line-record/recent-line lookup, charset/BOM handling, and file-cache selftests. In contrast, file-cache.h only declares char_span and the public file_cache API.
